caption: The drawing features a single clear goblet centered on a light beige background. The goblet has a wide bowl with a short stem and a circular, flat foot. The bowl is decorated near the rim with a horizontal band containing a pattern of parallel vertical lines. Below this band, there are scalloped arches accented by a series of oval dots, and at each scallop point, there are three small droplet-shaped decorations hanging downward. The lower portion of the goblet’s bowl features elongated teardrop or petal shapes radiating from the stem's base. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, giving the glass a transparent appearance, and the artist’s signature, "JOHN DANA," is written in small letters at the lower left corner of the page. The composition is minimal, with the goblet as the only object and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Rummer
